scale.1: implementation clues with observed critical failure
scale.5: repeated independent reproduction and public evidence

criteria.requirement: Complete a real firing/reload/pause/result/replay journey
Storage denial never blocks a visit
Superseded and destroyed camera/sensor requests release their resources
Startup and retry actions settle without reviving cancelled work
Ended or failed camera streams leave a usable training mode
Hidden calibration and gameplay remain stopped
Pause isolates controls and manages focus
Native keyboard actions and emergency pause work
Concurrent turn gestures have explicit ownership
Back-forward cache restores a paused, resumable app
Low drawing cadence preserves elapsed mission time
Inactive scenes stop continuous drawing
Malformed, reordered and stale orientation observations cannot steer
Compact touch controls and browser zoom remain usable
Native graphics loss has a usable fallback
Offline cache is namespaced and versioned against actual files
Local runtime and model assets have verified integrity/provenance
Accurate public guide, screenshots, own license and attribution
Fresh tracked-source lockfile install builds and checks
Repeatable desktop, touch and cross-engine end-to-end journeys

limitations: Implementation-agent judgments, not independent human ratings or physical camera/motion-device validation.
